title: SMS with AWS End User Messaging via Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda
description: Validate a phone number with Amazon Pinpoint and send an SMS with AWS End User Messaging SMS from an API Gateway REST API and Lambda.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern deploys an Amazon API Gateway REST API with IAM authorization and an AWS Lambda function using AWS SAM.

The function validates the destination phone number with the Amazon Pinpoint PhoneNumberValidate API, then sends an SMS from your origination identity with the AWS End User Messaging SMS SendTextMessage API.
